class.name: DrawableTexture2DArray
class.brief_description: A drawable 2D texture array with independently addressable layers and mipmaps.
class.description: [DrawableTexture2DArray] owns one physical drawable 2D-array texture. Every layer has the same dimensions, format, and mipmap count. Call [method setup] once before using the resource, then use the [code]texture_drawable_*[/code] methods on [RenderingServer] for exact layer and mipmap updates, copies, and readback. [method TextureLayered.get_layer_data] returns the complete stored mip chain, including independently uploaded lower levels. This diagnostic operation may stall rendering and perform repeated full-layer transfers; avoid it in normal runtime paths. Float-format readback may return [code]null[/code] on Compatibility backends that do not support the required framebuffer read format. The returned RID is a layered texture RID. It must only be used by consumers that explicitly support texture arrays, such as [CanvasTexturePageView]; never bind it where an ordinary [Texture2D] RID is expected. Replace the resource with a newly configured instance when its capacity or profile changes. Array mipmaps must be supplied explicitly with exact subresource updates or layer copies. Array RIDs are unsupported by [method RenderingServer.texture_drawable_blit_rect] and [method RenderingServer.texture_drawable_generate_mipmaps].

method.name: get_generation
method.description: Returns the physical drawable generation. A successfully configured resource begins at generation [code]1[/code]; an unconfigured resource returns [code]0[/code].

method.name: setup
method.description: Synchronously allocates the physical array and initializes every layer and mipmap to [param color]. [param layers] must not exceed [method RenderingServer.texture_drawable_get_max_array_layers]. Configuration is one-shot. A second call returns [constant @GlobalScope.ERR_ALREADY_IN_USE]. Invalid parameters or backend allocation failures return a non-[constant @GlobalScope.OK] result and leave the resource unconfigured.
